text:
taylor: Quick thought 1 - build a tiny edge 'decider' that fuses latency probes + a cheap quality signal and runs locally. Control-plane publishes compact policy; edges subscribe. Thoughts?

lee: Sounds good. Two quick constraints: keep hot-path decisions <2ms and make policy changes atomic.

anya: How do you define the cheap quality signal? small embedding distance to reference or a heuristic classifier?

morgan: Recommend a hybrid: heuristic checks for obvious failures + sampled async golden probes to update a short-term quality score. Keep sample rate low.

lee: Policy items we need: p95_threshold_ms, quality_threshold, fallback_sequence, sticky_key, probe_rate, cooldown_ms, rate_limit_per_min. Keep proto tiny.

(taylor posts a small proto snippet)

```
policy {
  p95_ms: 300
  quality_delta_pct: 5
  fallback_sequence: ["canary-v2","stable-v1"]
  sticky_by: "session_id"
  probe_sample_pct: 0.005
  cooldown_ms: 60000
}
```

anya: Edge state machine: OK -> SOFT_DEGRADE -> HARD_DEGRADE -> LOCKED. Emit events on transitions and keep them idempotent.

morgan: Ops needs a global kill-switch and per-region concurrent-fallback cap to avoid stampedes. Also signer for policy pushes.

lee: Telemetry: decision_reason, policy_version, probe_score, latency_p95, fallback_target. Keep sampled input/output pairs for a tiny fraction of traffic.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket RW-998 with a stubbed proto :white_check_mark:

anya: Make sure tenant exemptions are supported. Some customers opt-out of auto-fallback.

taylor: Agreed. Also add a debug endpoint /decider/last for quick triage.

morgan: Implementation plan: 1) proto + validation; 2) lightweight Go decider lib; 3) control-plane push + signed blobs; 4) probe harness + golden scorer; 5) canary in staging for 48h.

lee: Add a throttle: max X fallbacks/min per region and cooldown jitter to avoid synchronized rollbacks.

anya: I'll draft the operator runbook (freeze, force-fallback, pin tenant, rollback). Keep it one page.

(taylor) Closing: I'll open an RFC with the proto and perf targets. Thanks!
